notes.title: We're going free-to-play
notes.content:
Heroes of Xanfurth is going to be available on steam for the low price of FREE.

Let me clarify what I mean by free-to-play.
[list]
[*] No Micro-transactions.
[*] No DLC.
[*] Everything in the game will be available to anyone who clicks download.
[/list]
As somebody who loves gaming, both competitive and casual, I do not agree with some of the predatory monetization practices that other companies have placed into their games recently.  As a way to take my own stand against these practices I want to give everyone access to HoX for free.

I hope those of you who had the opportunity to play Heroes of Xanfurth have enjoyed your time with the game.  I am continuing to work on another project that I look forward to sharing with you in the near future.

Thank you and Happy Hunting,
Kayge

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Adjusted prices of Ninja and Dancer weapons in shops to more accurately reflect their power when compared to other class specific weapons.

The side-quest in Xanfurth has been rebalanced to more accurately reflect when it should be completed.

Other small quality of life changes...
